question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Benign
solution:
The solution is **Benevolent.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate synonym of " *Benign *" is Benevolent.
 
• **Benevolent - **Well meaning and kindly.
 
 
• *​For example : "A benevolent smile."*
 
 
 
• **Benign - **Gentle and kindly.
 
 
• *​For example : "Her face was calm and benign."*
 
 
 
• Therefore **option 3 **is the correct option.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's discuss information about other options :

 
 
• **Beneficiary - **A person who derives advantage from something, especially a trust, will, or life insurance policy.*​*

 
 
• *For example : "They took the beneficiary of his father after he died."*
 
 
 
• **Boisterous - **Noisy, energetic, and cheerful.** **
 
 
• *For example : "A group of boisterous girls."*
 
 
 
• **Boring - **Not interesting or tedious.
 
 
• *For example : "He has got a boring job in an office."*
